scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a first Bali trip in humid late May and early June, [X] plans a small set of tops for temple visits, rice-field walks, light hikes, beaches, snorkeling, boat time, and breezy evenings. [X] compares shoulder construction, sleeve volume, moving edges, and adjustability by how well they bridge respectful coverage and active comfort without requiring a separate outfit for every stop.
examples: using a controlled shoulder line at a temple without trapping too much heat
keeping sleeve volume manageable on a rice-terrace walk
saving a more open or visibly moving silhouette for beach time
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 首次在五月末至六月初前往湿热的巴厘岛时，[X]会为寺庙、稻田步行、轻徒步、海滩、浮潜、乘船和有海风的夜晚规划少量上衣，并比较不同肩部结构、袖子体积、活动边缘和可调节性，观察它们能否同时满足得体遮盖与活动舒适，而不必为每个停留点各准备一套衣服。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: As [X] repeats a beginner run-walk plan with arm-circle warm-ups, relaxed shoulders, ninety-degree arm swings, sweating, and cool-down, each moisture-managing training top is tested for whether its shoulder line moves cleanly, its armhole rubs or lifts, and loose sleeve volume catches air as sessions gradually lengthen.
examples: keeping the shoulder seam quiet during repeated arm swings
noticing underarm drag as running intervals become longer
securing an adjustable lower sleeve before warm-up
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在反复执行包含手臂绕环热身、放松肩部、约九十度摆臂、出汗和冷身的初级跑走计划时，[X]会随着训练时长逐渐增加，持续观察吸湿训练上衣的肩线能否顺畅活动、袖窿是否摩擦或上提，以及多余袖量是否兜风。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While following a fixed beginner yoga sequence, [X] takes a practice top through overhead reaches, hands-and-knees transitions, downward-facing dog, forward folds, bridge, twists, and floor relaxation. The changing orientations show [X] whether the sleeves preserve shoulder freedom, bunch at the armhole, fall toward the face, flutter, or expose the shoulders unexpectedly.
examples: checking shoulder freedom while both arms reach overhead
noticing loose edges move toward the face in an inverted pose
testing whether an open shoulder stays comfortable against the mat
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按照一套固定的初学者瑜伽流程练习时，[X]会让上衣依次经历举臂伸展、四点支撑转换、下犬式、前屈、桥式、扭转和躺地放松；身体方向的变化能让[X]看出袖子是否保留肩部自由、在袖窿处堆积、滑向脸部、随动作飘动，或意外露出肩部。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Without prior garment-design experience, [X] turns an imagined piece into a simple first top through sketching, a commercial or drafted pattern, a muslin, fabric selection, fitting, and construction. Before committing the final fabric, [X] compares sleeve structures by shoulder balance, volume, range of motion, seam difficulty, interaction with the neckline and silhouette, and the corrections required by the test garment.
examples: testing a standard or raglan shoulder in the muslin
reducing decorative volume when it distorts the intended silhouette
checking an open or adjustable sleeve before cutting final fabric
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 虽然没有服装设计经验，[X]仍会通过草图、商用或自制纸样、坯布样衣、选料、试身和缝制，把想象中的服装做成第一件简单上衣。在正式裁布前，还会比较不同袖型的肩部平衡、体积、活动范围、缝制难度、与领口及整体廓形的关系，以及样衣需要多少修正。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a child's ninth-birthday party at an indoor venue with climbing, slides, obstacle courses, and a treasure hunt, [X] chooses royal-themed play clothes that look festive in family photos while keeping the top's shoulder opening, decorative volume, and moving edges secure and clear of the child's hands, holds, and equipment during active play.
examples: keeping decorative upper-arm volume clear of climbing holds
watching a fluttering or bell-shaped edge during a slide
choosing an open shoulder that remains secure through obstacle play
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为孩子在室内游乐场举办的九岁生日会挑选皇室主题活动服时，[X]要兼顾攀爬、滑梯、障碍路线和寻宝等项目：上衣既要在家庭照片中有节庆感，肩部开口、装饰体积和活动边缘又必须在孩子活跃游戏时保持稳固，并避开双手、攀爬点和器械。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While commuting by public transport with a heavily loaded backpack containing a laptop, notebooks, water, chargers, and sometimes clothing, [X] compares work tops at the points where the contoured padded straps cross the shoulders: seams may lie flat or rub, gathered volume may compress and stay creased, and adjustable lower sleeves may help after a warm walk or crowded ride.
examples: placing the shoulder seam away from the main strap pressure point
checking whether gathered volume recovers after the bag comes off
adjusting the lower sleeve after a warm walk to the station
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 乘坐公共交通通勤时，[X]会背着装有笔记本电脑、笔记本、水、充电器和偶尔衣物的重型背包，并观察工作上衣在人体工学软垫肩带跨过肩部的位置会发生什么：接缝可能平贴或摩擦，褶量可能被压扁并留下皱痕，可调下袖则可能在走热或拥挤乘车后提供帮助。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After recently graduating, [X] prepares for an interview by uploading a photo of the actual outfit and agreeing to simplify it with a shirt or jacket according to company culture. Beneath the proposed outer layer, [X] checks the visible top's shoulder and arm silhouette for bunching, excess volume, deliberate exposure, and whether the result remains fresh and sharp on camera or in person.
examples: keeping the photographed shoulder line smooth under the jacket
reducing arm volume when it distracts from a formal presentation
checking whether an open shoulder changes how professional the outfit reads
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚毕业时，[X]在准备面试时上传实际穿搭照片，并同意根据公司文化尝试用衬衫或夹克简化造型；随后会检查照片中可追踪上衣的肩臂廓形在外层之下是否堆积、体积是否过大、是否有刻意露肩，以及最终效果在镜头或现场是否仍然清爽利落。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When a chosen warm-weather dress cannot be used until spring or summer, [X] considers adding a knitted upper layer and scarf so the gift can be worn in winter. [X] needs the added sleeves to sit smoothly over the dress, fit beneath outerwear, and preserve the intended elegant silhouette.
examples: keeping a quiet shoulder beneath a winter coat
using controlled arm volume beside a scarf
avoiding a moving sleeve edge that competes with the dress
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 当已经挑中的暖季连衣裙要等到春夏才能穿时，[X]会考虑加入针织上身层和围巾，让这份礼物在冬季也能使用；新增上衣的袖型需要平整地叠在裙装之上、放进外套之下，并保留原有的优雅廓形，而不是让多层互相拥挤。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building Victorian or steampunk cosplay as a hobby from modern garments used as-is or modified, [X] organizes base, middle, insulation, and armor layers from head to toe. Before treating any top as finished, [X] prototypes shirts and jackets against vests, arm plates, bracers, straps, heat, chafing, mobility, fastening, repair, and packing requirements.
examples: reshaping a shoulder so a base shirt sits cleanly under a vest
controlling decorative arm volume before adding a bracer
testing an open or adjustable section against armor straps
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把现代服装原样使用或加以改造来制作维多利亚或蒸汽朋克 cosplay 时，[X]会按从头到脚的顺序组织打底、中层、保温层和护甲层，并让候选衬衫和夹克在背心、臂甲、护腕、绑带、发热、摩擦、活动、固定、维修和打包要求下接受原型测试，不能在测试结束前把任何一件上衣视为成品。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a low-budget Brock closet cosplay, [X] searches for an orange V-neck shirt to wear beneath a green vest and backpack, compares premade, thrifted, and custom-sized routes, and relaxes exact screen accuracy in favor of comfort and availability. [X] still needs the shirt's shoulder and sleeve silhouette to remain recognizable beneath both neighboring layers without an expensive redesign.
examples: keeping the main shirt silhouette readable beneath the vest
placing the shoulder construction comfortably under backpack straps
altering an adjustable cuff on a thrifted find instead of ordering custom
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了低预算完成 Brock 衣橱 cosplay，[X]会寻找穿在绿色背心和背包下面的橙色 V 领上衣，比较成衣、二手和定制尺码路线，并放宽对屏幕形象完全一致的要求，优先考虑舒适和可获得性；不过，上衣的肩部与袖子廓形仍须在相邻两层之下可辨认，且不能要求昂贵重做。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a semi-outsourced six-guest birthday dinner, a hired server in a specified white shirt and black trousers plates food at the kitchen island, carries courses, pours wine, clears dishes, washes up, wipes the kitchen, and handles trash. Repeated service work exposes whether the shirt's sleeves stay controlled, permit shoulder reach, can be secured, or brush food, glassware, water, and handles.
examples: keeping fabric away from plated food while reaching across the island
rolling or securing a lower sleeve before loading the dishwasher
using a shoulder construction that stays easy while carrying a full platter
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一场半外包的六人生日晚餐中，受雇服务员按要求穿白衬衫和黑裤子，在厨房岛台摆盘、端菜、倒酒、收盘、洗碗、擦拭厨房并处理垃圾。反复服务工作会暴露衬衫袖子能否保持受控、是否允许肩部伸展、能否固定，以及是否会碰到食物、玻璃器皿、水和把手。
